value_policy: No secret values, token fragments, account IDs, Cloudflare store IDs, Cloudflare secret IDs, namespace IDs, passwords, or generated credentials are recorded.

entries.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_API_URL
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Update the production-backend Environment variable and redeploy affected runtimes.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: none; this is a non-secret endpoint

entries.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_API_TOKEN
consumers: backend Worker database compatibility API callers
worker-uplift stage services for final domain reads/writes after approval
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Generate a new bearer token, update the production-backend Environment secret, run protected backend apply so the loopback API accepts it, then redeploy callers.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: legacy Cloudflare NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_API_TOKEN binding can be removed only after Worker ingestion retirement

entries.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_POSTGRES_WORKER_API_PASSWORD
consumers: loopback backend Worker database compatibility API
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Rotate the dedicated backend PostgreSQL Worker API role password through protected Ansible apply and restart the loopback API.

entries.name: LOCAL_AI_API_KEY
entries.location: not present in production-backend at capture
consumers: future article approval service Qwen/local AI calls
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Retrieve the original local AI gateway key from the password manager or rotate the local AI gateway key, then store the new value as a production-backend Environment secret before deploying the approval service.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: legacy Cloudflare LOCAL_AI_API_KEY binding remains until Cloudflare Worker approval path is retired

entries.name: NUTSNEWS_SHADOW_SMOKE_TOKEN
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Generate a validation-only token in the protected validation environment when the shadow smoke workflow is implemented.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: legacy worker non-production shadow smoke token can be retired after new shadow smoke flow replaces it

entries.name: SUPABASE_URL
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Rotate from Supabase project settings only if legacy rollback needs it.

entries.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Do not copy into uplift services. Rotate Supabase backend automation equivalents only through production-backend if protected migration workflows need them.

entries.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
entries.owner: ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker for legacy fallback; ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend only for maintenance robot
entries.location: Cloudflare Secrets Store for legacy fallback; production-backend maintenance robot secret is not a worker-uplift runtime credential
consumers: backend maintenance robot outside worker uplift
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Do not reuse the maintenance robot OpenAI key for worker-uplift services. Create a separate approved fallback credential only if a later AI fallback decision requires it.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: explicit OpenAI fallback retirement or approval decision

entries.name: SENTRY_DSN
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Do not recreate unless a later observability decision selects Sentry.

entries.name: BETTER_STACK_SOURCE_TOKEN
entries.owner: ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker for legacy logs; ramideltoro/nutsnews-infra for future observability resources
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Rotate in Better Stack only while legacy Worker log delivery remains enabled.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: Grafana/observability migration and legacy Worker retirement

entries.name: BETTER_STACK_INGESTING_HOST
entries.owner: ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker for legacy logs; ramideltoro/nutsnews-infra for future observability resources
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Treat as a non-secret host if retained; do not inject into uplift by default.
entries.legacy_revocation_dependency: Grafana/observability migration and legacy Worker retirement

entries.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Do not recreate unless a later runtime locking decision selects Upstash.

entries.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Do not recreate unless a later runtime locking decision selects Upstash.

entries.name: NUTSNEWS_FAILOVER_STATUS_HMAC_SECRET
entries.owner: ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker controller until failover ownership moves
entries.rotation_or_update_procedure: Rotate only through the failover controller owner boundary.

validation.value_free_live_check: gh secret list/gh variable list against production-backend, names only
blocked_items_are_intentional: LOCAL_AI_API_KEY must be provided or rotated before article approval service bootstrap
NUTSNEWS_SHADOW_SMOKE_TOKEN must be generated before protected shadow smoke workflows
